_comment: Official ELEGOO OTA 02.01.01.13, captured on 2026-11-08 from the user's own printer (online update, hard-linked by tools/capture/ota_keeper.sh). Outer, inner and manifest ELEG signatures verify with keys/cc2_stock_public.pem and both embedded payload SHA-256 values match. Pins were measured with tools/inspect_base.py and unsquashfs 4.7.5. The build stays refused: the manifest fields need the AES input and no patch set is ported to this base.
_comment_stock_package: the device stored it as /opt/usr/firmware/elegoo_firmware; this is the file name embedded in its outer ELEG header plus .sig
_comment_manifest: version and update_class of the decrypted official ota-package-list.json (inspect_base.py with --aes-key). Not readable without the AES input; copy them, never invent or raise them. opt/inst/firmware_version/versions.json in this rootfs reports ota_version 02.01.01.13.
_comment_ported_patch_set: true only after Z-offset (GUI), HTTP/network (elegoo_printer) and camera (ai_camera) patches are ported to this base, emulation-tested and hardware-tested. daemon-000 and libcolib.so are byte-identical to 02.01.01.07.
